parsed.note_claim: The suspect's name Hamam al-Hammami is a real name (the Arabic given name Hamam/Hammam), contradicting the post's claim that it is not a real name.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The pilot is an Omani citizen named Hamam al-Hammami, according to the two sources and an Israeli official. Saudi state media also identified al-Hammami.
